quote: “Little feet of children / blue with cold, / how can they see you and not cover you— / dear God!”
source: Gabriela Mistral, Piececitos (Little Feet), lines 1 to 4, Selected Poems of Gabriela Mistral (trans. Doris Dana, 1971)

evidence.where: Favorite Poem Project page printing the bilingual poem with Dana’s translation and the Johns Hopkins 1971 copyright credit
evidence.edition: Selected Poems of Gabriela Mistral, trans. and ed. Doris Dana (Johns Hopkins University Press, 1971)
evidence.locator: Piececitos / Little Feet, first stanza, lines 1 to 4

reason: Dana’s opening stanza matches the proposal exactly in wording, lineation and the dash; the page credits the 1971 Johns Hopkins edition by permission. The Spanish first stanza sits beside it.
